historical_sources: R11 and portable source retain their own historical terminology and unadopted proposals. No canonical glossary adoption, model or backend execution follows.
scope: The inventory covers the browser data companion, desktop launchers, reproducible movement benchmarks, navigation and historical source previews. The paper collections also carry their own content manifests.
launcher_update: The desktop shortcuts open the palm replay. The companion also includes sample inspection and alignment.
base_public_commit_scope: Historical original payload base; not the head or whole-tree seal for later context changes.

paper_content.scope: Selected experimental paper content, kept outside these 108 subset rows; actual publication/readback is recorded separately.

download_bundle.scope: Four exact selected PDFs, three companions, README, content manifest and five notice files. No standalone font, source, model or private evidence files. Native extraction/PDF-link behavior across operating systems remains unverified.

context_overlay_basis.meaning: Frozen input inventory only; no new commit or upload is asserted by this file.

selected_source.scope: 77 cleared TeX/BibTeX files. The manifest identifies omitted build dependencies.

latest_contact_force_preview.scope: Two offline grip-force forecasts compared after the tenth consecutive sample at or above 0.5 N on the 500 Hz recording clock. Adding aligned scalp EEG increased average error in both families on the same explored development cohort. Final test reserved. The launchers use invented input by default.

browser.scope: Frozen ridge and causal CNN weights run on the same prior window. An invented example or compatible local JSON supplies inputs. A future target sample can be shown only when supplied. Rotation is an aggregate control. The 120 ms horizon is on the recording clock.

hygrip_force.status: Protocol and source coverage after TRAIN work began and before DEV or FINAL access.
hygrip_force.scope: Cued right-hand power grip in a separate dataset. Target is a transducer-voltage reading 120 ms ahead on the released clock.

browser.trial_replay: One right-hand trial per local file; 205 scheduled cutoffs, conditional on complete input and target support. The example is invented.
browser.signal_plot: Twenty 50 Hz transducer readings and a selectable forecast at +120 ms. Trial outcomes are shown only when revealed.

latest_hygrip_results_preview.scope: First scoring of three original HYGRIP development participants after public protocol posting. The browser uses fixed TRAIN fits and invented example inputs by default. FINAL remains reserved.

secondary_emg.tested_endpoint: forecast of released sensor voltage 120 ms after issue
secondary_emg.scope: Secondary right-hand analysis on the same three previously studied development people. Timing-specific forearm EMG and scalp EEG directional screens failed on TRAIN and DEV.

hygrip_cue_phase.scope: Comparison of cue-conditioned and shared voltage dynamics on the previously studied healthy HYGRIP cohort.
hygrip_cue_phase.outcome: The phase-conditioned residual did not beat the original full-history benchmark on either split. Previously studied development cohort. The full-history ridge remains selected.

study.scope: Index-finger sensor voltage on a distinct two-day isometric task. Physical real-time lead remains unverified.
study.decision: No average primary incremental gain from aligned EMG in this experiment; held-participant and day-specific results reported.

latest_hyser_release.scope: Released index transducer voltage 120 ms ahead on the nominal stream. Four final participants reserved. No online or clinical claim.

crossday_study.scope: Matched Day 1 supervised calibration on an output offset and gain, followed by fixed Day 2 scoring. Shared model had the lowest mean Day 2 MAE on the four previously studied DEV participants. Paired-donor control and pair-level descriptive uncertainty are reported.

latest_hyser_release.personal_reader: Two original same-person session folders, five labeled first-day trials, fixed second-day inference. Population mode remains available.

whole_hand.scope: Five force sensors, four prespecified fits including one other-trial control, and three same-trial predictors. MAE favored different models in the 12-person training comparison and four previously studied development participants. Reserved final participants remain unopened.

prescribed_task.scope: Unchanged Random-task weights scored on 360 prescribed N-DoF trials in 12 original fit participants and 120 in four previously evaluated development participants. Across all combinations, persistence gave lowest MAE and five histories lowest RMSE in each group. No refits. Original final participants remain excluded.

hyser_crossday.scope: Matched Day 1 supervised calibration on an output offset and gain, followed by fixed Day 2 scoring. Shared model had the lowest mean Day 2 MAE on the four previously studied DEV participants. Paired-donor control and pair-level descriptive uncertainty are reported.

hyser_whole_hand.scope: Five force sensors, four prespecified fits including one other-trial control, and three same-trial predictors. MAE favored different models in the 12-person training comparison and four previously studied development participants. Reserved final participants remain unopened.

hyser_prescribed_task.scope: Unchanged Random-task weights scored on 360 prescribed N-DoF trials in 12 original fit participants and 120 in four previously evaluated development participants. Across all combinations, persistence gave lowest MAE and five histories lowest RMSE in each group. No refits. Original final participants remain excluded.

cemhsey_pinch.scope: Offline normalized scalar P200 pinch-force recording. Three fit participants over two days, four different evaluation participants on different indexed days. The public reader includes an invented model and supports local fit import; the study fit stays private. No cross-device physical availability or individual finger force inference.

cemhsey_array_reader.publication_scope: The public example includes invented signals and fitted example weights. A compatible locally supplied recording and locally supplied weights can be loaded in the browser.
cemhsey_array_reader.local_band_profile: Import a calibration profile bound to these weights or fit one from separate local packets.

cemhsey_interval_design.status: Measured held comparison of pooled and cue-phase widths; public single-trial example uses invented values.

cemhsey_force_transfer.status: Second-repeat evaluation independently reproduced across three targets.
cemhsey_force_transfer.limitations: Four previously studied adults, one indexed day, fixed repeat order and nominal timing; public examples and bundled weights are invented.

cemhsey_day_transfer.status: Second repeats on the next indexed day independently scored, source-scope checked.
cemhsey_day_transfer.limitations: One pair of indexed days, four previously studied participants, one prescribed task and nominal 120 ms timing. Public reader uses invented signals and weights by default.

cemhsey_population_phase.status: Design fixed before reading either new block of measurements.
